items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Don Roby (?) run it, and, uh...we, uh, used to play there sometimes a month in the nightclub

ctx.x: Then, every summer we take off and go down through Texas and Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee. We play all over the South. I don't think there's a place in the South where I ain't never been. I made so many stops...one-nighters...call me "One-Nighters Joe." 'Course, Ray Charles, Bobby Blue Bland, B.B. King an' all them fellows, they were doin' the same thing. That's all we played was one-nighters. We didn't play too many nightclubs. When we did, we just stayed three days... weekends...and we had a lot of fun…

So we talkin' about whenever anybody would have a good night ...made some extra money...we'd all come out and have a good time the next day. I had a friend of mine called Herman the German. I met him down in Houston, Texas. I was workin' at a place called the Peacock Nightclub. Don Roby (?) run it, and, uh...we, uh, used to play there sometimes a month in the nightclub, and so I run into Herman the German
